description: Shared Renovate config of the homelab repos (infrastructure, smart-home, private-cloud, homelab-engineering). Extend it with github>TheRealArthurDent/renovate:homelab; repo-specific rules stay in the repo's renovate.json.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions are pinned to a commit SHA (the version stays as a comment) and every update of them, digest and pin updates included, waits for minimumReleaseAge. The release timestamp is required here: GitHub tags and releases always have one.
GitHub Actions: minor, patch, pin and digest updates in one PR, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass. The rulesets require a PR for main, so a branch automerge can't push there.
GitHub Actions majors: a PR each, merged by hand.

pre-commit hooks: minor, patch, pin and digest updates in one weekly PR, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass. renovatebot/pre-commit-hooks alone releases almost daily. The ansible-lint hook is left out: it goes with the pip packages in the repos' ansible-devtools group.

Docker image patches: merged by GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass, and only once the release is minimumReleaseAge old. The release timestamp is required here, so an image without one (only Docker Hub has them; ghcr.io and other registries don't) isn't auto-merged on day one: those are left out and stay PRs merged by hand. The merge lands on main; it reaches the Pis with the next Ansible run.
